tags.description: Laowai is a 1930s Shanghai-inspired speakeasy hidden behind the unassuming BLND TGER dumpling shop in Chinatown, where the secret code "7" unlocks a world of theatrical cocktails and share plates.
tags.description:en: Laowai is a 1930s Shanghai-inspired speakeasy hidden behind the unassuming BLND TGER dumpling shop in Chinatown, where the secret code "7" unlocks a world of theatrical cocktails and share plates.
tags.description:fr: Laowai est un speakeasy inspiré des années 1930 à Shanghai, caché derrière le modeste magasin de dumplings BLND TGER dans le quartier chinois, où le code secret « 7 » ouvre les portes d’un univers de cocktails théâtraux et de plats à partager.
tags.description:ja: Laowaiは、チャイナタウンにあるひっそりとしたBLND TGER餃子店の奥に隠された、1930年代の上海をモチーフにしたシークレットバーです。秘密のコード「7」を入力すると、舞台のようなカクテルやシェアプレートの世界が広がります。レストランオーナーのLewis Hartとそのチームによって考案されたこの場所は、創意工夫に富んだドリンク、美食餃子、禁酒法時代の魅力への遊び心溢れるオマージュを融合させた没入型の体験を提供します。
tags.description:ko: Laowai는 차이나타운의 소박한 BLND TGER 만두 가게 뒤에 숨겨진 1930년대 상하이에서 영감을 받은 스피크이지입니다. 비밀 코드 "7"을 사용하면 극적인 칵테일과 공유 접시의 세계가 열립니다. 레스토랑 경영자 Lewis Hart와 그의 팀이 구상한 이 몰입감 있는 공간은 창의적인 음료, 고급 만두, 그리고 금주법 시대의 매력을 재치 있게 결합한 특별한 경험을 선사합니다.
tags.description:zh: Laowai 是一家受1930年代上海风情启发的秘密酒吧，隐藏在唐人街那家朴实无华的 BLND TGER 饺子店后面，只有输入神秘密码“7”才能开启充满戏剧性鸡尾酒和共享小盘的世界。由餐厅老板 Lewis Hart 及其团队构想，这个精心设计的小场所带来了一种沉浸式体验，将创意饮品、美味饺子与禁酒时代的魅力巧妙结合。
tags.name: Laowai

tags.description: Bagheera is a hidden speakeasy cocktail bar in Vancouver's Chinatown, accessed through the fictional Happy Valley Turf Club. With Jungle Book-themed decor, it offers expertly crafted cocktails and small Indian dishes in a cozy atmosphere.
tags.description:en: Bagheera is a hidden speakeasy cocktail bar in Vancouver's Chinatown, accessed through the fictional Happy Valley Turf Club. With Jungle Book-themed decor, it offers expertly crafted cocktails and small Indian dishes in a cozy atmosphere.
tags.description:fr: Bagheera est un bar secret derrière le fictif Happy Valley Turf Club à Vancouver, avec une décoration inspirée du Livre de la jungle. Les clients savourent des cocktails raffinés et des plats indiens dans une atmosphère immersive, parfaite pour soirée.
tags.description:ja: バギーラは、バンクーバーのチャイナタウンにある架空のハッピーバレー競馬クラブの外観の裏に位置する隠れたスピークイージーのカクテルバーです。豪華なジャングルブックをテーマにした装飾と独特の入場プロセスを特徴としており、ゲストは居心地の良い没入型の雰囲気の中で、巧みに作られたカクテルや小さな風味豊かなインド料理を楽しむことができ、特別な夜のお出かけに最適なスポットです。
tags.description:ko: 바기라는 밴쿠버 차이나타운의 허구의 해피 밸리 경마 클럽 외관 뒤에 위치한 숨겨진 스피크이지 칵테일 바입니다. 화려한 정글 북 테마 장식과 독특한 입장 프로세스를 특징으로 하며, 손님들은 아늑하고 몰입감 있는 분위기 속에서 정교하게 제작된 칵테일과 작은 인도 요리를 즐길 수 있어 특별한 밤 외출에 완벽한 장소입니다.
tags.description:zh: Bagheera 是一家隐藏的秘密酒吧，位于温哥华唐人街虚构的快乐谷赛马俱乐部的外表后面，拥有奢华的《丛林之书》主题装饰和独特的入场流程。客人可以在舒适、沉浸的氛围中享用精心调制的鸡尾酒和小份美味的印度菜肴，是一个完美的特别夜晚去处。
tags.name: Bagheera

tags.description: Biography of Masumi Mitsui, a Japanese Canadian WW1 Veteren whom the Greenway is named after.
tags.inscription:1: Sergeant Masumi Mitsui (1887-1987), a Japanese Canadian First World War veteren, fought at Vimy and was awarded the Military Medal for Bravery at Hill 70. After the war, as president of the Japanese Branch #9 of the Canadian Legion,
tags.inscription:2: he campaigned to enfranchise all Japanese Canadians, but in 1931 the vote was only extgended to veterans. During the Second World War, approximately 22,000 Japanese Canadians, including his family, were uprooted and dispossessed of their property.
tags.inscription:3: The Mitsui family was interned and then dispered to resettle in Ontario. In 1985, Mitsui was honoured to relight the lantern, extenguished in 1942, atop the Japanese Canadian War Memorial in Stanley Park.
tags.name: Masumi Mitsui Greenway
